# Plemio

> Plemio is a B2B lead generation agency that uses personalized cold email outreach to reach decision-makers and deliver interested prospects to clients' sales teams.

Plemio's pricing has two parts: a fixed monthly fee from $900 for campaign infrastructure and a price from $35 per lead. The exact lead price and monthly volume are agreed before launch. A lead is a prospect's reply showing interest or requesting a next step; an unsubscribe or a reply saying the offer is not relevant is not a lead. Results and timing vary by campaign.

## Website

- [Plemio home page](https://ple-mio.com/): Service overview and contact form.
- [How it works](https://ple-mio.com/#how): Targeting, contact research, outreach and lead handoff.
- [Pricing](https://ple-mio.com/#prices): Monthly fee, per-lead pricing and example.
- [Campaign results](https://ple-mio.com/#cases): Examples from steel structures, coffee and IT development.
- [Frequently asked questions](https://ple-mio.com/#faq): Lead definition, timing, pricing and campaign expectations.
- [Discuss a project](https://ple-mio.com/#discuss): Contact form for a lead forecast and project discussion.
